conditions: Two real headless Chromium browsers on this workstation plus three passive WebSocket peers. Desktop viewport 1560x1080, second browser resized to 390x844. Region interiors were staged through isolated QA-server stdin; four boundary crossings and the mobile desert crossing used normal map buttons and authoritative movement.

memory.evictionObserved: After snow -> ice, cached variants dropped from 10 to 3 and rendered texture count from 46 to 40 after the unused-material grace period. Snow was subsequently entered again with source sharing intact.

fps.note: These are the recorded one-second observations after arrival and during short boundary walks on this workstation. They do not guarantee 60 FPS during every load or on other devices. Prior 43–60 FPS observations remain valid history.
